key_points: Philip Morris raised its quarterly dividend 8.8% to $1.60 per share (annualized $6.40) in September 2026.
Smoke-free products now represent 42% of net revenue, supporting the dividend growth narrative.
Upcoming ex-dividend dates are days away, creating short‑term buying pressure for yield‑focused investors.
Analysts note the stock appears fairly valued; some models flag it as slightly overvalued.
No new earnings, guidance, or material operational news released in the past few days.
